canvas_base.description: The educator's Canvas host, e.g. https://school.instructure.com. Non-secret connector config, visible to the agent.

moodle_base.description: The educator's Moodle host, e.g. https://moodle.school.edu. Non-secret connector config, visible to the agent.

description: Product pin set for Morrow for Muse. Canvas operations use the Chromium lane. Moodle uses the separate HTTPS session lane in moodle/ and its site-level capability probe. There are no multi-step Canvas manifest entries: `entries` is intentionally empty (fail-closed: `execute --entry` refuses every entry name until entries are pinned here with sha256 verified against in-dist manifests). NOTE (2026-09-21): the 14 sha256 pins that used to live here were REMOVED, not re-pointed, because every pinned path pointed OUTSIDE the carved tree (../provision/manifests/*, ../catalog/a11y/*, ../../gap-audit/f13-test-manifest.json). In the shipped artifact those pins were unverifiable by the educator and protected nothing; shipping them implied a guarantee the dist could not keep.

rules: Plan mode: writes use a frozen plan digest and educator authorization; plan/action mismatch refuses. Edit mode: explicit standing authorization permits scoped writes without per-action approval, except destructive confirmation when enabled.
Catalog enforcement: only operations marked live-proven in proof-battery/OPERATION_CATALOG.md dispatch. Nothing overrides that, not even the educator asking.

Approvals: in Plan mode, the actual educator reply authorizes the exact frozen action. Records are digest-bound, category-scoped, unexpired and single-use. Never invent authorization. Edit mode follows its standing grant and configured destructive confirmation.
Journaling: every dispatch appends one record; consumed op ids are never reused.
Session death: the executor journals claim/release state and pauses writes. Never retry an uncertain effect blindly. Verify the account and saved provider state before an explicitly authorized retry.
Write halt: if ~/.morrow/write_halt exists, all writes refuse.
Fail closed: 4xx fails fast; uncertain writes are never retried.

Provider routing: Canvas catalog operations use the Chromium executor; Moodle operations use the separate moodle/ session lane and its site-level capability probe. Never route one provider through the other provider's executor.

Learner data: operations whose responses carry people dispatch only on the Chromium lane with the encrypted learner vault, de-identified before the agent or the journal sees them; every other lane refuses them. Nothing is gated or restricted by tenant (parity law).
Scope: v1 includes the Canvas connector and separate Moodle session lane. Blackboard is an honestly-disclosed roadmap item, not a ship criterion.

name: morrow-for-muse-product
